# Qwen8 PP4 GEMM 保存对象与重算

逐矩阵所需输入按身份去重，列出原非矩阵保存引用、归stage和语义释放点。

阶段F/B时间仅提供保守reservation包络，不是allocator实际峰值。

| assumptions[0] | Fixed dense full-token Qwen3-8B PP4. Each linear dW needs its forward input, each linear dX needs resident W. Bilinear QK/PV require both operands; no output tensor is saved merely because a GEMM produced it. |
| assumptions[1] | Norm z/r is pre-gamma normalized value, not weighted GEMM input. SwiGLU a/s/u are not a*u. New identities distinguish these products instead of falsely aliasing them. |
| assumptions[2] | Save_inputs preserves all added FP32 reference operands. Recompute_products reconstructs only weighted norm outputs and a*u, using public saved values; Q/K/V/context remain saved. |
| assumptions[3] | Under existing recompute_silu, its sigmoid/a pair is reconstructed once before down-projection dW and retained through SwiGLU backward. Existing public two-vector workspace and scalar/special counts are reused, not added again. |
| assumptions[4] | One layer backward at a time; product temporary is freed after its last GEMM consumer before the next reconstructed product. Reserve max one product buffer throughout each stage B, conservatively. |
| assumptions[5] | Tensor objects explicitly label semantic producer and last consumer. Stage timing only resolves F/B envelopes; these are reservations, not exact physical allocation lifetimes. |
| assumptions[6] | FP32 saved operands define a mathematical reference strategy. Vendor kernel dtype/packing, expanded-GQA materialization and allocator workspace remain implementation dependent. |
| assumptions[7] | Token/label IDs, transient gradients, parameter/optimizer state, communication-to-internal-copy ownership, casting and other non-saved buffers are excluded. More complete GEMM saves still do not prove total training peak. |
